commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Thomas Leonard has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Hamari Traore (Paris FC) picks up an injury.
90+4' Angers are ruled offside.
90+3' A pass lands at the feet of Louis Mouton (Angers) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Excellent touch by Carlens Arcus (Angers)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Florent Hanin (Angers) for Jacques Ekomie.
87' Here is a change. Yassine Belkhdim is going off and Alexandre Dujeux gives the last tactical orders to Lilian Raolisoa (Angers).
87' A substitution has been made. Adama Camara goes off and Marshall Munetsi (Paris FC) comes on.
86' The cross fools the defence and leaves Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the right post.
86' Luca Koleosho (Paris FC) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the right post.
85' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) is able to continue to play.
83' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
83' Carlens Arcus (Angers) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
82' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Luca Koleosho (Paris FC) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
79' Some great play by Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Herve Koffi sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
77' The corner is swung in but Paris FC can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
74' We are about to witness a substitution. Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) is replacing Ilan Kebbal.

74' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Jim Allevinah (Angers) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
69' The players claim that Louis Mouton (Angers) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
68' Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
67' Haris Belkebla (Angers) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
66' Total attempts – 4:4.
61' It's time for a substitution. Jim Allevinah (Angers) comes on in place of Amine Sbai.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Harouna Djibirin trots off the pitch and is replaced by Branco van den Boomen (Angers).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Prosper Peter (Angers) replaces Sidiki Cherif.
60' Stephane Gilli decides to make a substitution. Alimani Gory will be replaced by Luca Koleosho (Paris FC).
60' The referee signals a substitution. Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) is brought on as a substitute for Vincent Marchetti.
60' Stephane Gilli has decided to make a change. Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) replaces Jean-Philippe Krasso.
59' Louis Mouton (Angers) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
58' Harouna Djibirin (Angers) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
56' Harouna Djibirin (Angers) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
56' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
53' Alimani Gory (Paris FC) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.

52' Adama Camara (Paris FC) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Herve Koffi was alert and the score remained the same.
51' Herve Koffi (Angers) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
49' Herve Koffi (Angers) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
49' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Amine Sbai (Angers) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
46' Hamari Traore (Paris FC) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Herve Koffi, who smothers the ball.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Harouna Djibirin (Angers) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
41' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
39' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
36' Looks like Sidiki Cherif (Angers) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
33' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
30' The ball possession at the moment is 61:39.
26' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
26' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Paris FC.
25' Timothee Kolodziejczak (Paris FC) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
24' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC).
22' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
18' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Paris FC.

16' What a huge chance for Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
12' Hamari Traore (Paris FC) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
12' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp is equal to it and makes an easy save.
11' Thomas Leonard blows for a foul after Hamari Traore (Paris FC) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
10' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Thomas Leonard blows for a foul.
6' Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC) makes a strong challenge and Thomas Leonard blows for a foul.
5' Amine Sbai (Angers) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.

3' Harouna Djibirin (Angers) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Paris FC will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Angers will take the kick-off.
Thomas Leonard will officiate today.
